title: Prime Minister shares an article by former ISRO Chairman Shri Somanath Sreedhara Panicker highlighting India's space achievements and roadmap for future missions
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has shared an article written by former ISRO Chairman, Shri Somanath Sreedhara Panicker. The article reflects on how the Prime Minister's leadership and a clear national vision helped turn India's space ambitions into reality. It highlights the significance of the Indian Space Policy 2023 in opening up the space sector to private players and discusses the roadmap for India's future missions, including human spaceflight, the Bharatiya Antariksh Station and deeper lunar exploration. The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X: “A giant leap to the Moon and an even bigger vision for India's future in space!
